L0526

A constant `true` condition never exits without a `break`; a constant `false` condition never enters the body

What

A constant `true` condition never exits without a `break`; a constant `false` condition never enters the body

Why

A constant loop condition either never exits or never runs; the condition is not dynamic.

Fix

For `true`, write `loop { … }`; for `false`, remove the loop or change the condition
